```{r}
## Load required libraries
need <- c("tidyverse", "lubridate", "zoo", "forecast", "TSA", "tseries")
to_install <- need[!suppressWarnings(sapply(need, requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE))]
if (length(to_install)) install.packages(to_install, dependencies = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(lubridate)
  library(zoo)
  library(forecast)
  library(TSA)
  library(tseries)
})
```

```{r}
#Data Source Description (Required in Project)
dataset_link  <- "https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/rohanrao/formula-1-world-championship-1950-2020"
dataset_desc  <- "Dataset containing Formula 1 race, pit-stop, constructor and lap-time records (1950–2020); Ferrari pit-stop durations are extracted for nonseasonal analysis."

dataset_link
dataset_desc

```

```{r}
#Load Raw CSVs
pit_raw         <- read_csv("pit_stops.csv")
races_raw       <- read_csv("races.csv")
results_raw     <- read_csv("results.csv")
constructors_raw <- read_csv("constructors.csv")

```

```{r}
#Identify Ferrari Constructor
ferrari_ids <- constructors_raw %>%
  filter(str_detect(tolower(name), "ferrari")) %>%
  pull(constructorId) %>% unique()

ferrari_ids

```

```{r}
#Filter Ferrari Pit-Stops and Join Race Metadata
# Filter Ferrari race results
ferrari_results <- results_raw %>%
  filter(constructorId %in% ferrari_ids) %>%
  select(raceId, driverId)

# Join pit stops correctly (FIXED COMMA)
pit_ferrari <- pit_raw %>%
  inner_join(ferrari_results, by = c("raceId", "driverId"))

# Add race metadata
races_small <- races_raw %>%
  select(raceId, year, date) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))

pit_ferrari <- pit_ferrari %>%
  left_join(races_small, by = "raceId") %>%
  filter(year >= 2000)

sum(is.na(pit_ferrari$milliseconds))


```

```{r}
#Aggregate to Race-Level Series
pit_ferrari_race <- pit_ferrari %>%
  group_by(year, date, raceId) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pit_ms = mean(milliseconds, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_pit = n(),
    n_missing = sum(is.na(milliseconds)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(date)

pit_ferrari_race <- pit_ferrari_race %>% mutate(race_index = row_number())

pit_ts <- ts(pit_ferrari_race$mean_pit_ms, start = 1, frequency = 1)

pit_ts

```

```{r}
#Handle Missing Values & Outliers
pit_ts_imp <- na.approx(pit_ts, na.rm = FALSE)
pit_ts_imp <- na.locf(pit_ts_imp, na.rm = FALSE)
pit_ts_imp <- na.locf(pit_ts_imp, na.rm = FALSE, fromLast = TRUE)

out_info <- tsoutliers(pit_ts_imp)
out_info

pit_ts_adj <- pit_ts_imp
if (length(out_info$index) > 0) {
  pit_ts_adj[out_info$index] <- out_info$replacements
}

```

```{r}
#Exploratory Plots
par(mfrow = c(1,1))

plot(pit_ts_adj,
     main = "Ferrari Pit-Stop Duration per Race (Adjusted)",
     xlab = "Race Index",
     ylab = "Average Pit Time (ms)")

hist(pit_ts_adj, main = "Histogram of Pit-Stop Duration", xlab = "Milliseconds")

boxplot(pit_ts_adj,
        main = "Boxplot of Pit-Stop Duration",
        ylab = "Milliseconds")

summary(pit_ts_adj)

```

```{r}
#Trend Line & Stationarity (ADF, ndiffs)
time_index <- time(pit_ts_adj)
lm_trend <- lm(as.numeric(pit_ts_adj) ~ time_index)

plot(pit_ts_adj)
abline(lm_trend, col="red", lwd=2)

adf.test(pit_ts_adj)

d_order <- ndiffs(pit_ts_adj)
d_order

pit_ts_diff <- diff(pit_ts_adj, differences = d_order)

plot(pit_ts_diff,
     main = paste("Differenced Series (d =", d_order, ")"))

```

```{r}
#ACF & PACF
par(mfrow = c(1,2))
acf(pit_ts_diff, main = "ACF of Differenced Series")
pacf(pit_ts_diff, main = "PACF of Differenced Series")
par(mfrow = c(1,1))

```

```{r}
#Fit Candidate ARIMA Models
fit_auto <- auto.arima(pit_ts_adj, seasonal = FALSE)

fit_011 <- Arima(pit_ts_adj, order = c(0, d_order, 1))
fit_110 <- Arima(pit_ts_adj, order = c(1, d_order, 0))
fit_111 <- Arima(pit_ts_adj, order = c(1, d_order, 1))
fit_210 <- Arima(pit_ts_adj, order = c(2, d_order, 0))
fit_211 <- Arima(pit_ts_adj, order = c(2, d_order, 1))

model_table <- tibble(
  Model = c("Auto", "ARIMA(0,1,1)", "ARIMA(1,1,0)", "ARIMA(1,1,1)", "ARIMA(2,1,0)", "ARIMA(2,1,1)"),
  AIC = c(AIC(fit_auto), AIC(fit_011), AIC(fit_110), AIC(fit_111), AIC(fit_210), AIC(fit_211)),
  BIC = c(BIC(fit_auto), BIC(fit_011), BIC(fit_110), BIC(fit_111), BIC(fit_210), BIC(fit_211))
)

model_table

```

```{r}
#Residual Diagnostics (Full Requirements)
checkresiduals(fit_auto)

hist(residuals(fit_auto), main = "Residual Histogram", xlab = "Residuals")

qqnorm(residuals(fit_auto)); qqline(residuals(fit_auto))

shapiro.test(residuals(fit_auto))

```

```{r}
#Train–Test Split + Accuracy Evaluation
n <- length(pit_ts_adj)
h <- 20

train <- pit_ts_adj[1:(n - h)]
test  <- pit_ts_adj[(n - h + 1):n]

fit_train <- auto.arima(train, seasonal = FALSE)

fc_test <- forecast(fit_train, h = h)

accuracy(fc_test, test)

```

```{r}
#Final Model & Forecast Plot
fit_final <- fit_auto

fc_final <- forecast(fit_final, h = 20)

plot(fc_final,
     main = "Forecasted Ferrari Pit-Stop Durations",
     ylab = "Milliseconds")

```
